Name: MAGIC_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines spells (sorceries and incantations): costs, stat requirements, catalyst type, use restrictions, stat- and SpEffect-based replacement, and up to ten Attack, Bullet or SpEffect references that the casting animation fires. The spell's inventory entry (icon, sort order) is the EquipParamGoods row with the same ID.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds. Not read by the retail game.
Reserved. Appears unused by the game.
Reserved. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Confirmation Dialog Message ID
Fields.Description: Text of the Yes/No confirmation used by the menu the spell opens (Menu Opened on Use). Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Category Block Bypass SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: While the caster has this SpEffect active, the Blocking SpEffect Category restriction is ignored. Other restrictions still apply. −1: none. Retail: always −1.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. The spell's inventory sort order is that of its EquipParamGoods row (same ID).

Fields.Name: Requirement: ARC
Fields.Description: Arcane needed to cast the spell: it can't be cast below this. Also shown in the spell's menu details.

Fields.Name: AI Notification Type
Fields.Description: Notification sent to the AI system when the spell activates: 1 and 2 send two different notifications (the AI reaction to each was not traced). 0: none. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: FP Cost
Fields.Description: FP spent when a reference slot whose Consumption Type is Default fires. Multiplied by the caster's SpEffect FP cost rate for the Spell Type (Sorcery, Incantation or Pyromancy FP Consumption %) and rounded. The spell can't be cast without enough FP, and this is the FP cost shown in the menu.

Fields.Name: Stamina Cost
Fields.Description: Stamina spent when a reference slot whose Consumption Type is Default fires, passed through the caster's stamina cost calculation.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. The menu icon comes from the spell's EquipParamGoods row (same ID); retail values here don't match the icons shown.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Material Item ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always −1.

Fields.Name: Replacement Spell ID - SpEffect State
Fields.Description: Magic ID cast in place of this spell while the caster has an active SpEffect of the Replacement SpEffect State. Checked after the stat-based replacement, on the spell that results from it. −1 or 0: none. Retail: always −1.

Fields.Name: Casts per Memorised Copy
Fields.Description: Leftover limited-casts system from earlier games. 0 or more: each memorised copy holds three times this many cast units and a cast uses 3 (2 or 6 under some SpEffect states), so the value is the number of casts. −1: unlimited. Retail: always −1.

Fields.Name: Reference Type [1]
Fields.Description: What Reference ID [1] points to: 0 Attack (AtkParam_Pc), 1 Bullet, 2 SpEffect.

Fields.Name: Dexterity over Start Value
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 99.

Fields.Name: Reference Type [2]
Fields.Description: What Reference ID [2] points to: 0 Attack (AtkParam_Pc), 1 Bullet, 2 SpEffect.

Fields.Name: Memory Slots Used
Fields.Description: Memory slots the spell takes when memorised; the game adds this up over all memorised spells. Also shown in the menu.

Fields.Name: Requirement: INT
Fields.Description: Intelligence needed to cast the spell: it can't be cast below this. Also shown in the spell's menu details.

Fields.Name: Requirement: FTH
Fields.Description: Faith needed to cast the spell: it can't be cast below this. Also shown in the spell's menu details.

Fields.Name: Casting Speed - DEX Start
Fields.Description: DEX at which casting speed starts to improve. The cast animation's cancel point moves linearly from no speed-up at or below this DEX to the full speed-up at or above Casting Speed - DEX End. The DEX used includes SpEffect Cast Speed + bonuses. Retail: 10 on player spells, 1 on NPC spells.

Fields.Name: Casting Speed - DEX End
Fields.Description: DEX at which casting speed reaches its full speed-up (see Casting Speed - DEX Start). A value below the start is raised to it; equal values give the full speed-up at any DEX. Retail: 70 on player spells, 20 on NPC spells.

Fields.Name: Spell Type
Fields.Description: 0 Sorcery, 1 Incantation, 2 Pyromancy, 3 Vow Magic (2 and 3 are leftovers). Sets which catalysts can cast it (armament flags Enables Sorcery / Incantations / Pyromancy / Vow Magic), which SpEffect FP cost rate applies, the type text in the menu, and the attack category used for some attack modifiers. 3 also requires the caster's covenant to be allowed by the Covenant flags.

Fields.Name: Reference Type [3]
Fields.Description: What Reference ID [3] points to: 0 Attack (AtkParam_Pc), 1 Bullet, 2 SpEffect.

Fields.Name: Attack Behavior Category
Fields.Description: Category of the spell's attacks, used to decide which SpEffect attack modifiers apply to them (same categories as the goods and accessory fields). Retail: 3 Sorcery or 4 Incantation.

Fields.Name: Casting Animation Type
Fields.Description: Casting animation set the spell uses, read by the character's animation state machine (EzState) to pick the cast animation.

Fields.Name: Menu Opened on Use
Fields.Description: Menu opened when the spell is used (same options as goods). 0: none. A spell with a menu is blocked while that menu can't be opened. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Reference Type [4]
Fields.Description: What Reference ID [4] points to: 0 Attack (AtkParam_Pc), 1 Bullet, 2 SpEffect.

Fields.Name: Replacement SpEffect State
Fields.Description: SpEffect state type that triggers Replacement Spell ID - SpEffect State. 0: none. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Replace Category
Fields.Description: Adds a replace level to the Reference IDs while certain SpEffect states are active: 1 uses Replace Level 1/2 (+1/+2), 2 uses Item Replace Level 1–4 (+1 to +4). 0: none. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Blocking SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: The spell can't be cast while the caster has an active SpEffect of the category this value stands for (some values cover several categories, as the option names show), unless the Category Block Bypass SpEffect is active. 0: no limit. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Covenant 0 Allowed
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant filter: the spell can only be cast when the caster's covenant (vow) type has its flag on; this is the flag for type 0. Elden Ring has no covenants. Retail: always on.

Fields.Name: Usable During Multiplayer
Fields.Description: The spell can be cast while a multiplayer session is active. Off: blocked during multiplayer (and in one further character state that was not identified). Retail: always on.

Fields.Name: Only Usable During Multiplayer
Fields.Description: The spell is blocked unless an online multiplayer session is active. Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Armament Buff Spell
Fields.Description: The spell can only be cast when the armament it buffs is buffable (Is Buffable in EquipParamWeapon). Retail: the armament buffs such as Scholar's Armament.

Fields.Name: Shield Buff Spell
Fields.Description: The spell can only be cast when the shield it buffs can guard (Enables Guard in EquipParamWeapon). Retail: Scholar's Shield.

Fields.Name: Usable as Host
Fields.Description: The spell can be cast in your own world as a normal (host) player.

Fields.Name: Usable as Gray Phantom
Fields.Description: The spell can be cast while in the gray (offline phantom) state.

Fields.Name: Usable as Cooperator
Fields.Description: The spell can be cast as a cooperating phantom (summoned or Hunter).

Fields.Name: Usable as Invader
Fields.Description: The spell can be cast as a hostile phantom (invader or duelist).

Fields.Name: Blocked While Offline
Fields.Description: The spell is blocked while the game isn't connected online. Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Cast Resonance Magic
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Toughness Check at Base Poise
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Blocked by Warp Ban
Fields.Description: The spell is blocked while the Warp Ban SpEffect state (278) is active. Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Usable While Riding
Fields.Description: The spell can be cast while mounted. Off: blocked while mounted.

Fields.Name: Only Usable While Riding
Fields.Description: The spell is blocked while not mounted. Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Usable in No-Attack Areas
Fields.Description: The spell can be cast while the No-Attack Area SpEffect state (457) is active (for example at the Roundtable Hold). Off: blocked there.

Fields.Description: SFX spawned by the casting animation's spell-SFX events that ask for the cast effect. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Toughness Correction
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Stat Replacement - Stat
Fields.Description: Stat checked for the stat-based replacement: 0 STR, 1 DEX, 2 FTH, 3 INT. Slots are checked from 4 down to 1: the first Replacement Threshold the caster's stat is above picks that slot's Replacement Spell ID, and if that ID is −1 the spell isn't replaced. Retail: Carian Retaliation becomes 4641 above 34 INT and 4642 above 51 INT.

Fields.Name: Replacement Threshold [1]
Fields.Description: The caster's Stat Replacement stat must be above this (not equal) for Replacement Spell ID [1]. Checked from slot 4 down to 1, first match wins; −1 always matches, so a −1 threshold with a −1 spell ends the check without replacing.

Fields.Name: Replacement Threshold [2]
Fields.Description: The caster's Stat Replacement stat must be above this (not equal) for Replacement Spell ID [2]. Checked from slot 4 down to 1, first match wins; −1 always matches, so a −1 threshold with a −1 spell ends the check without replacing.

Fields.Name: Replacement Threshold [3]

Fields.Name: Replacement Threshold [4]

Fields.Name: Poise Consumption
Fields.Description: Super armor (poise) value stored with the cast when a reference slot with Consumption Type Default or Charged fires (0 for None); what then uses it was not traced. Retail: 1 on 17 spells (for example Dragonclaw), else 0.

Fields.Name: Replacement Spell ID [1]
Fields.Description: Magic ID cast in place of this spell when the stat is above Replacement Threshold [1] (first match from slot 4 down to 1). −1: no replacement.

Fields.Name: Replacement Spell ID [2]
Fields.Description: Magic ID cast in place of this spell when the stat is above Replacement Threshold [2] (first match from slot 4 down to 1). −1: no replacement.

Fields.Name: Replacement Spell ID [4]

Fields.Name: Stamina Cost - Charged
